name: devbrain-ai
description: DevBrain AI — local-first desktop platform for multi-agent software development.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter @devbrain/desktop typecheck
scripts.validate: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:secrets && pnpm --filter @devbrain/desktop build && pnpm run smoke:desktop
